project_info.theme: Nighttime fashion editorial with rain frozen around a walking model
project_info.color_palette: neutral beige dress, wet charcoal street, white droplets, cool blue-black city and warm lights

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman captured mid-step with wet hair moving naturally, wearing a flowing modern neutral-toned dress and a light coat caught by the motion. Her expression is calm and editorial, with realistic skin tones and natural posture.
main_subject.style: 8K ultra-photorealistic nighttime fashion editorial with cinematic realism

composition_elements.layout: vertical 9:16 full-body street portrait with subject moving through frozen rainfall
composition_elements.background: dark cinematic urban street at night with wet reflective pavement, distant building lights and shallow bokeh

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: powerful direct on-camera flash with cool ambient night light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: sparkling frozen droplets, dramatic contrast, crisp skin and fabric motion with cinematic urban depth

technical_specs.optics: fast portrait lens, shallow depth of field, high-speed shutter to freeze droplets and motion

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an 8K ultra-photorealistic nighttime fashion editorial of a generic clearly adult woman captured mid-step as rain freezes around her using powerful on-camera flash. She wears a flowing modern dress in neutral tones with a light coat, the fabric caught naturally in motion, while wet hair moves softly with her movement. Set the scene on a dark cinematic urban street with sparkling frozen droplets, wet reflective pavement, distant city lights, shallow depth of field, dramatic contrast, realistic skin tones and ultra-sharp focus. Use a 9:16 vertical composition, high-speed shutter and cinematic editorial realism. No text and no watermark. Preserve the source's movement, neutral fashion styling, rain effect and urban-night concept without adding a public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicated droplets, distorted limbs
